 ### Product images
 
 Both backend product endpoints must include `imageOrder` on every image.
 Missing, fractional, or negative orders fail response validation rather than
 silently displaying an incorrect image order.
 
 The browser never contacts the backend directly, so `API_BASE_URL` can be an internal-only address. Backend image URLs such as `/images/product-1.svg` are rewritten to the same path on this frontend, and `GET /images/:fileName` fetches the image from the backend on the server and returns it. Only single, plain file names under the backend's `/images/` path are proxied; anything else (other hosts, nested paths, `..`) is dropped from the page or returns `404`. +++ b/public/menu.js
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+(() => {
+  const toggle = document.getElementById('menu-toggle')
+  const menu = document.getElementById('site-menu')
+  const overlay = document.getElementById('menu-overlay')
+  const close = document.getElementById('menu-close')
+  if (!toggle || !menu || !overlay || !close) return
+  overlay.hidden = false
+
+  const focusable = () =>
+    Array.from(menu.querySelectorAll('a[href], button:not([disabled])'))
+
+  function setOpen(open) {
+    menu.dataset.open = String(open)
+    overlay.dataset.open = String(open)
+    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open))
+    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu')
+    document.body.classList.toggle('menu-open', open)
+    if (open) focusable()[0]?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
+    else toggle.focus({ preventScroll: true })
+  }
+
+  const isOpen = () => menu.dataset.open === 'true'
+
+  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(!isOpen()))
+  close.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false))
+  overlay.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false))
+
+  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
+    if (!isOpen()) return
+    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
+      setOpen(false)
+      return
+    }
+    if (event.key !== 'Tab') return
+    const items = focusable()
+    const first = items[0]
+    const last = items[items.length - 1]
+    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
+      event.preventDefault()
+      last.focus()
+    } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
+      event.preventDefault()
+      first.focus()
+    }
+  })
+})()

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..97677a7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/app.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+import { once } from 'node:events'
+import nunjucks from 'nunjucks'
+import request from 'supertest'
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { createApp } from './app'
+
+describe('GET /health', () => {
+  it('returns the service status and uptime', async () => {
+    const server = createApp().listen(0)
+    await once(server, 'listening')
+
+    try {
+      const address = server.address()
+      if (address === null || typeof address === 'string') {
+        throw new Error('Expected the server to listen on a TCP port')
+      }
+
+      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}/health`)
+
+      expect(response.status).toBe(200)
+      await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({
+        status: 'ok',
+        uptime: expect.any(Number),
+      })
+    } finally {
+      server.close()
+      await once(server, 'close')
+    }
+  })
+})
+
+describe('site menu', () => {
+  it('renders safely without current-page context', () => {
+    const env = new nunjucks.Environment(new nunjucks.FileSystemLoader('views'), {
+      autoescape: true,
+    })
+    const html = env.render('login.njk', {})
+
+    expect(html).toContain('Welcome back')
+    expect(html).not.toContain('aria-current=')
+  })
+
+  it.each([
+    ['/login', '/login', 'page'],
+    ['/register', '/register', 'page'],
+    ['/products', '/products', 'page'],
+    ['/products/missing', '/products', 'location'],
+    ['/login?returnTo=%2Faccount', '/login', 'page'],
+  ])('highlights the current menu destination on %s', async (path, href, current) => {
+    const response = await request(
+      createApp({
+        fetchProducts: async () => [],
+        fetchProduct: async () => null,
+      }),
+    ).get(path)
+
+    expect(response.text).toContain(`href="${href}" aria-current="${current}"`)
+    expect(response.text.match(/aria-current=/g)).toHaveLength(1)
+  })
+
+  it('does not highlight an unrelated destination', async () => {
+    const response = await request(createApp()).get('/forgot-password')
+
+    expect(response.text).not.toContain('aria-current=')
+  })
+
+  it.each(['/login', '/products', '/register'])(
+    'renders the burger menu on %s',
+    async (path) => {
+      const response = await request(
+        createApp({ fetchProducts: async () => [] }),
+      ).get(path)
+
+      expect(response.text).toContain('id="menu-toggle"')
+      expect(response.text).toContain('aria-controls="site-menu"')
+      expect(response.text).toContain('href="/products"')
+      expect(response.text).toContain('src="/static/menu.js"')
+    },
+  )
+})
